description: This file defines a public enum 'OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction' with nested structs, methods for processing agent messages, JSON serialization, and dispatching UI actions within a Canvas-based interface in a Swift project.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction.AgentMessageContext
classes.description: A structure representing the context of an agent message, including session and component details.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction.AgentMessageContext.Session
classes.description: A structure holding session-related identifiers such as key and surfaceId.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction.AgentMessageContext.Component
classes.description: A structure holding component-related identifiers such as id, host, and instanceId.

methods.name: extractActionName
methods.description: Extracts the action name from a user action dictionary, searching for 'name' or 'action' keys.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValue
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be a valid tag value by trimming, replacing spaces, and removing invalid characters.

methods.name: compactJSON
methods.description: Converts a JSON-serializable object into a compact JSON string, if valid.

methods.name: formatAgentMessage
methods.description: Formats and creates a string representing an agent message for UI actions, incorporating context and session details.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2UIActionStatus
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript snippet that dispatches a browser event indicating the status of an A2UI action.
